title: Stone belongs to its region
notes: An optional regional stone treatment lets loose ash bury more slabs while wind-scoured Bonepale exposes broader stone patches. Each place supplies its own coverage and slope tendency, blending smoothly at region boundaries.

Enable WAR_REGION_STONE=1 together with WAR_GROUND_PLATES=1 to inspect it. Ordinary launches and the existing plates preview remain unchanged; slab identities, the original terrain and saved characters stay intact.
Raised tops, their collision, edge chips and the cave's ground contact use the same regional decision. Fresh builds and live changes agree, including after a cave rebuild.

Fixed Bonepale and Cinderreach views show the coverage change, but tiled shapes, edge wear, contact shadows and the hardware performance acceptance still need work. This default-off experiment does not clear the stone or Phase 0 art gate.
